skill_name: What is the best way to improve accuracy in a deep learning model?
workflow: The best way to improve accuracy in a deep learning model is to use data augmentation, which involves creating additional training data by manipulating existing data. This increases the size and variability of the dataset, resulting in a model that generalizes better and can better capture patterns in the data.
